story.text: 출근 시간이 살짝 지난 오후, 역사 안은 그래도 사람들로 북적였다. 규현이 성큼성큼 개찰구 쪽으로 앞서 걸어갔다.
story.reading: chul-geun si-gan-i sal-jjak ji-nan o-hu, yeok-sa an-eun geu-rae-do sa-ram-deul-lo buk-jeok-yeot-da. gyu-hyeon-i seong-keum-seong-keum gae-chal-gu jjok-eu-ro ap-seo geol-eo-gat-da.
story.en: It was just past rush hour, but the station was still crowded with people. Kyuhyun strode ahead toward the ticket gates.

story.text: "지하철 타본 지 오래됐죠?" 그가 뒤돌아보며 씩 웃었다. "저만 믿고 따라오면 돼요, 아가씨."
story.reading: "ji-ha-cheol ta-bon ji o-rae-dwaet-jyo?" geu-ga dwi-dol-a-bo-myeo ssik us-eot-da. "jeo-man mid-go tta-ra-o-myeon dwae-yo, a-ga-ssi."
story.en: "It's been a while since you rode the subway, hasn't it?" He glanced back and grinned. "Just trust me and follow along, miss."

story.text: 내가 교통카드를 찍으려다 단말기에 두 번이나 튕기자, 그가 옆에서 낮게 웃으며 손끝으로 카드 방향을 살짝 바로잡아 주었다.
story.reading: nae-ga gyo-tong-ka-deu-reul jjig-eu-ryeo-da dan-mal-gi-e du beon-i-na tweong-gi-ja, geu-ga yeop-e-seo nat-ge us-eu-myeo son-kkeut-eu-ro ka-deu bang-hyang-eul sal-jjak ba-ro-jab-a ju-eot-da.
story.en: As I tried to tap my transit card and got rejected by the reader twice, he chuckled beside me and gently adjusted the card's angle for me.

story.text: 플랫폼에 서서 그가 설명했다. "여기서 두 정거장 가서, 2호선으로 환승해야 해요. 안내 방송 잘 들어요, 알겠죠?"
story.reading: peul-laet-pom-e seo-seo geu-ga seol-myeong-haet-da. "yeo-gi-seo du jeong-geo-jang ga-seo, i-ho-seon-eu-ro hwan-seung-hae-ya hae-yo. an-nae bang-song jal deul-eo-yo, al-get-jyo?"
story.en: Standing on the platform, he explained. "We go two stops from here, then transfer to Line 2. Listen carefully for the announcement, got it?"

story.text: 열차 안은 발 디딜 틈 없이 붐볐다. 손잡이 하나를 사이에 두고 나란히 선 규현이 몸을 살짝 기울여 사람들 사이의 공간을 만들어 주었다.
story.reading: yeol-cha an-eun bal di-dil teum eop-si bum-byeot-da. son-jab-i ha-na-reul sa-i-e du-go na-ran-hi seon gyu-hyeon-i mom-eul sal-jjak gi-ul-yeo sa-ram-deul sa-i-ui gong-gan-eul man-deul-eo ju-eot-da.
story.en: Inside the train, there wasn't even room to set a foot down. Standing beside me, sharing one handle, Kyuhyun leaned his body slightly to make a little space for me among the crowd.

story.text: 환승을 마치고 밖으로 나오니, 버스 정류장 표지판이 눈에 들어왔다. "저기예요. 5분 뒤에 버스 와요." 그가 정류장을 가리켰다.
story.reading: hwan-seung-eul ma-chi-go bakk-eu-ro na-o-ni, beo-seu jeong-nyu-jang pyo-ji-pan-i nun-e deul-eo-wat-da. "jeo-gi-ye-yo. o-bun dwi-e beo-seu wa-yo." geu-ga jeong-nyu-jang-eul ga-ri-kyeot-da.
story.en: After finishing the transfer and stepping outside, a bus stop sign came into view. "There it is. The bus comes in five minutes." He pointed to the stop.

story.text: 버스에 올라 창가 자리에 앉자 그가 작게 속삭였다. "이번에 내려요. 벨 누르는 거, 이번엔 아가씨가 해볼래요?" 나는 웃으며 조심스레 하차 벨을 눌렀다.
story.reading: beo-seu-e ol-la chang-ga ja-ri-e anj-ja geu-ga jak-ge sok-sag-yeot-da. "i-beon-e nae-ryeo-yo. bel nu-reu-neun geo, i-beon-en a-ga-ssi-ga hae-bol-lae-yo?" na-neun us-eu-myeo jo-sim-seu-re ha-cha bel-eul nul-leot-da.
story.en: As we boarded the bus and sat by the window, he whispered, "We're getting off at this stop. Want to press the bell this time?" I laughed and carefully pressed the stop button.

words.example_en: I commute to work by subway.
Tap your transit card on the reader.
I'm waiting for the bus at the stop.
I'll get off at the next station.

sentences.en: Does this bus go to Gangnam?
I'll get off at the next station.
Which line do I transfer to?
I'm getting off at this stop.
